string.text: Polymer buffer
Addition of a polymer buffer to the return mechanism reduces felt recoil.
Barrel adjustment
Reduces bullet dispersion, which improves accuracy.
Faster twist rate
Increases muzzle velocity, thus improving the flatness of the trajectory. Useful for long range fire.
Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Tactical device
Insight AN/PEQ-16a tactical block combines the functions of a laser sight and a tactical flashlight. Particularly useful in night conditions.
Anatomical pistol grip
Provides better grip for the right arm.
Lightweight parts
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts without any significant loss in other performance characteristics.
Magazine spring
Thinner spring allows to slightly increase the capacity of the magazine.
Improved feeding mechanism
Decreases the probability of malfunctions related to feeding issues.
Improved ejector
Modification of the case ejector reduces the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Tactical foregrip
Adds Picatinny rails to the handguard. Tactical foregrip attached to one of the rails improves handling. Additional rails allow installation of tactical accessories.
Trigger tuning
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Lightweight handguard
Reduces overall weight of the firearm.
Balanced bolt
Balanced bolt carrier group reduces the muzzle climb, as well as reduces the probability of malfunctions.
Chamber adjustment
Improves obturation and accuracy by removing play in the chamber.
Lightweight stock
Reduces overall weight of the firearm.
Rubberized recoil pad
Anatomical rubberized recoil pad reduced felt recoil.
Bolt adjustment
Exact fit of the bolt carrier group reduces play, which improves accuracy.
Rate reducer
Reduces bullet dispersion, making the shooting more controllable, as well as helps to conserve ammunition. Reduces heating of the barrel, which has a positive effect on the durability.
